:root {
  interpolate-size: allow-keywords;
  --bitty-switch-off: #778;
  --bitty-switch-on: #0a0;
  --bitty-switch-text: white;
}

* {
  margin: 0;
}

*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

::marker {
  color: var(--default-base-color);
}

html {
  scrollbar-gutter: stable;
}

body {
  background-color: var(--default-background-color);
  color: var(--default-base-color);
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  font-size-adjust: 0.5;
  font-size: var(--default-font-size);
  line-height: var(--default-line-height);
  background-image: var(--svg-bg-url);
  background-size: 150px 150px;
  background-repeat: repeat;
  /*
  text-shadow: 0px 0px 4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.6);
  */
}

a {
  color: var(--default-info-color);
  text-decoration: none;
}

a:focus {
  color: var(--default-accent-color);
}

a:hover {
  color: var(--default-accent-color);
}

aside {
  margin-left: 20vw;
  font-style: italic;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--faded-reverse-color);
  padding: var(--default-padding);
}

b {
  font-weight: var(--xxlarge-font-weight);
}

.backmatter {
  padding-bottom: var(--xxlarge-padding);
  border-bottom: var(--faded-base-border);
}

.blue {
  color: blue;
}

.bitty-switch {
  display: block;
}

.bitty-switch button {  
  background-color: var(--bitty-switch-off);
  border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0);
  border-radius: 1rem;
  color: var(--bitty-switch-text);
  height: 1.2rem;
  padding: 0;
  position: relative;
  transform: translateY(0.25rem);
  width: 3.1rem;
}

.bitty-switch button:hover {  
  border: 1px solid var(--bitty-switch-text);
  color: var(--bitty-switch-text);
}

.bitty-switch button[aria-checked="true"]  {
  background-color: var(--bitty-switch-on);
}

.bitty-switch button :nth-child(1):after,
.bitty-switch button :nth-child(1):before {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-53%);
}

.bitty-switch button :nth-child(2):after,
.bitty-switch button :nth-child(2):before {
  border-radius: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  width: 1rem;
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
}

.bitty-switch button[aria-checked="true"] :nth-child(1):before {
  content: "on";
  left: 0.35rem;
}

.bitty-switch button[aria-checked="true"] :nth-child(2):before {
  background: var(--bitty-switch-text);
  right: 0.25rem;
}

.bitty-switch button[aria-checked="false"] :nth-child(1):after {
  content: "off";
  right: 0.35rem;
}

.bitty-switch button[aria-checked="false"] :nth-child(2):after {
  background: var(--bitty-switch-text);
  left: 0.25rem;
}

@supports (interpolate-size: allow-keywords) {
  details {
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  details::details-content {
    block-size: 0;
      transition: 
        block-size 170ms,
        content-visibility 170ms;
      transition-behavior: allow-discrete;
  }

  details[open]::details-content {
    block-size: auto;
  }
}

.image-block {

  details {

      content: "▼ ";

      display: inline-block;

  }
